scope: 仅从DDL及临时内存PRAGMA生成；未读取日常数据库或真实患者数据。
notes: nullable_by_ddl按PRAGMA notnull原样；SQLite普通rowid表的非INTEGER PRIMARY KEY可能接受NULL，文档应标明主键设计必填但DDL未显式NOT NULL，不虚称物理完全强制。
时间大多为UTC ISO文本；会话、恢复令牌、限流及幂等创建时间为Unix毫秒；business_date和quarter按UTC+8业务时间。
金额以整数分存储；单位面积为平方米；比例为REAL。
users.data仍为兼容身份JSON；核心业务实体及明细已使用类型列，审计与幂等响应为JSON快照。

tables.name: metadata
tables.title: 系统元数据
tables.meaning: 记录初始化版本等键值元数据。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.title: 数据库迁移记录
tables.meaning: 保存迁移版本、名称、校验和与执行时间。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,checksum TEXT NOT NULL,applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: clinics
tables.title: 门诊
tables.meaning: 保存门诊名称、地址、主管、联系方式、面积及启用状态。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE clinics(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,address TEXT NOT NULL,supervisor TEXT NOT NULL,phone TEXT NOT NULL,email TEXT,area REAL NOT NULL CHECK(area>0),active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN(0,1)),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: dentists
tables.title: 医生
tables.meaning: 保存医生工号、身份资料和联系方式；医生可跨门诊排班。

columns.name: employee_no
columns.label: 医生工号（不区分大小写唯一）

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE dentists(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,employee_no TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,name TEXT NOT NULL,dob TEXT,phone TEXT NOT NULL,email TEXT,address TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN(0,1)),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: qualifications
tables.title: 资格
tables.meaning: 定义牙科执业及专业资格目录。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE qualifications(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,issuer TEXT NOT NULL,description TEXT,active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN(0,1)),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: dentist_qualifications
tables.title: 医生资格关联
tables.meaning: 将医生与资格组成多对多关联。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE dentist_qualifications(dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,qualification_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qualifications(id),position INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(dentist_id,qualification_id))

tables.name: dentist_qualification_details
tables.title: 医生资格核验明细
tables.meaning: 按医生和资格保存证书编号、核验资料及展示顺序。

columns.name: verified_by
columns.label: 核验账号编号（逻辑引用）

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE dentist_qualification_details(dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,qualification_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qualifications(id),certificate_no TEXT,verified_at TEXT,verified_by TEXT,note TEXT,position INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(dentist_id,qualification_id))

tables.name: treatments
tables.title: 治疗项目
tables.meaning: 定义治疗项目、计量单位、参考单价及启用状态。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE treatments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,unit TEXT NOT NULL,unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price>=0),active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN(0,1)),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: patients
tables.title: 患者档案
tables.meaning: 保存身份、联系方式、紧急联系人、过敏声明及归并指向。

columns.name: phone_normalized
columns.label: 去空格与连字符的电话生成列

columns.name: allergy_verified_by
columns.label: 临床核验账号编号（逻辑引用）

columns.name: active
columns.label: 是否有效；历史空值按有效处理

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE patients(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL,dob TEXT,phone TEXT NOT NULL,phone_normalized TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS(replace(replace(phone,' ',''),'-','')) STORED,email TEXT,address TEXT,emergency_name TEXT,emergency_phone TEXT,allergy_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(allergy_status IN('unknown','none','known')),allergy_declared_at TEXT,allergy_verified_by TEXT,allergy_verified_at TEXT,allergy_source TEXT,created_clinic_id TEXT REFERENCES clinics(id),created_at TEXT,active INTEGER CHECK(active IN(0,1)),merged_into_id TEXT REFERENCES patients(id),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: patient_allergies
tables.title: 患者过敏明细
tables.meaning: 保存每项过敏物、反应及补充说明。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE patient_allergies(patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,id TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,reaction TEXT,note TEXT,position INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(patient_id,id))

tables.name: patient_clinic_access
tables.title: 患者门诊访问关联
tables.meaning: 保存机构核验后允许接触患者档案的门诊。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE patient_clinic_access(patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),position INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(patient_id,clinic_id))

tables.name: schedules
tables.title: 可预约时段
tables.meaning: 把医生、门诊和起止时间组成容量为1的排班时段。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE schedules(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id),start_at TEXT NOT NULL,end_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(end_at>start_at),capacity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(capacity=1),active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN(0,1)),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: appointments
tables.title: 预约
tables.meaning: 记录患者预约、到诊、爽约、取消及改约链。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE appointments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id),clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id),schedule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedules(id),start_at TEXT NOT NULL,end_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(end_at>start_at),problem TEXT NOT NULL,special_needs TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('booked','attended','no_show','cancelled')),attended INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attended IN(0,1)),previous_id TEXT REFERENCES appointments(id),created_at TEXT,cancel_reason TEXT,cancelled_at TEXT,status_reason TEXT,status_changed_at TEXT,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: visits
tables.title: 就诊记录
tables.meaning: 到诊后形成就诊记录；完成后冻结正文并允许附记。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE visits(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,appointment_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES appointments(id),patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id),clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id),problem TEXT,special_needs TEXT,notes TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('open','completed')),completed_at TEXT,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: visit_lines
tables.title: 就诊治疗明细
tables.meaning: 保存一次就诊的多个治疗项目、数量及价格快照。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE visit_lines(visit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,id TEXT NOT NULL,treatment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES treatments(id),name TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price>=0),position INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(visit_id,id),UNIQUE(visit_id,treatment_id))

tables.name: settlements
tables.title: 结算单
tables.meaning: 依据完成就诊生成唯一结算单及开单时金额。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE settlements(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,visit_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES visits(id),patient_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id),clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id),date TEXT NOT NULL,total INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total>=0),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: settlement_lines
tables.title: 结算单明细
tables.meaning: 保存治疗项目名称、单价、数量及小计的开单快照。

columns.name: subtotal
columns.label: 行小计（数量×单价，整数分）

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE settlement_lines(settlement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES settlements(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,position INTEGER NOT NULL,id TEXT,treatment_id TEXT REFERENCES treatments(id),name TEXT NOT NULL,quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unit_price>=0),subtotal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(subtotal=quantity*unit_price),PRIMARY KEY(settlement_id,position))

tables.name: costs
tables.title: 季度成本
tables.meaning: 按季度、门诊、医生记录耗材与运营成本及复核状态。

columns.name: reviewed_by
columns.label: 复核账号编号（逻辑引用）

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE costs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,quarter TEXT NOT NULL,clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id),supplies INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(supplies>=0),operations INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(operations>=0),evidence TEXT,note TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('draft','reviewed')),reviewed_by TEXT,reviewed_at TEXT,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),UNIQUE(quarter,clinic_id,dentist_id))

tables.name: cost_review_history
tables.title: 成本复核历史
tables.meaning: 按顺序保存成本复核或撤回复核的历史。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE cost_review_history(cost_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES costs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,position INTEGER NOT NULL,at TEXT,user_id TEXT,action TEXT,version INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(cost_id,position))

tables.name: quarterReports
tables.title: 季度报告
tables.meaning: 保存季度收入、成本、净利润、基金及来源签名。

columns.name: revenue
columns.label: 开单收入减冲销（整数分）

columns.name: net_profit
columns.label: 收入减两类成本（整数分）

columns.name: fund
columns.label: 按规则计提基金（整数分）

columns.name: negative_profit_policy
columns.label: 亏损时的基金处理规则

columns.name: approved_by
columns.label: 批准账号编号（逻辑引用）

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE quarterReports(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,quarter TEXT NOT NULL,revenue INTEGER NOT NULL,supplies INTEGER NOT NULL,operations INTEGER NOT NULL,net_profit INTEGER NOT NULL,fund INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(fund>=0),fund_rate REAL NOT NULL,negative_profit_policy TEXT,revenue_basis TEXT,status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('draft','approved')),created_at TEXT,scope TEXT,source_signature TEXT,approved_by TEXT,approved_at TEXT,invalidated_at TEXT,invalidated_reason TEXT,version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: quarter_report_clinics
tables.title: 报告门诊范围
tables.meaning: 将季度报告关联到纳入核算的门诊。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE quarter_report_clinics(report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quarterReports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),position INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(report_id,clinic_id))

tables.name: quarter_report_rows
tables.title: 报告核算行
tables.meaning: 保存每个门诊—医生组合的收入、成本及成本版本快照。

columns.name: revenue
columns.label: 开单收入减冲销（整数分）

columns.name: net_profit
columns.label: 收入减两类成本（整数分）

columns.name: cost_version
columns.label: 纳入报告的成本版本号

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE quarter_report_rows(report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quarterReports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,position INTEGER NOT NULL,clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),dentist_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dentists(id),revenue INTEGER NOT NULL,supplies INTEGER NOT NULL,operations INTEGER NOT NULL,net_profit INTEGER NOT NULL,cost_id TEXT REFERENCES costs(id),cost_version INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(report_id,position))

tables.name: quarter_report_settlements
tables.title: 报告行结算关联
tables.meaning: 将报告行关联到收入来源结算单。

columns.name: item_position
columns.label: 该报告行结算关联顺序

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE quarter_report_settlements(report_id TEXT NOT NULL,position INTEGER NOT NULL,settlement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES settlements(id),item_position INTEGER NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(report_id,position) REFERENCES quarter_report_rows(report_id,position) ON DELETE CASCADE,PRIMARY KEY(report_id,position,settlement_id))

tables.name: quarter_report_history
tables.title: 报告操作历史
tables.meaning: 保存报告计算、批准及失效过程的顺序历史。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE quarter_report_history(report_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES quarterReports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,position INTEGER NOT NULL,at TEXT,action TEXT,user_id TEXT,version INTEGER,prior_status TEXT,prior_version INTEGER,PRIMARY KEY(report_id,position))

tables.name: settings
tables.title: 业务参数
tables.meaning: 保存自助取消期限和基金比例等全局设置。

columns.name: cancellation_hours
columns.label: 自助取消/改约提前小时数（0至168）

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE settings(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,cancellation_hours INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cancellation_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 168),fund_rate REAL NOT NULL CHECK(fund_rate>=0 AND fund_rate<=1),version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0))

tables.name: users
tables.title: 账号
tables.meaning: 保存用户名、密码摘要与兼容身份JSON；角色、姓名等有同步类型列。

columns.name: username
columns.label: 登录名（不区分大小写唯一）

triggers.name: users_sync_insert
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER users_sync_insert AFTER INSERT ON users BEGIN UPDATE users SET role=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.role'),name=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.name'),patient_id=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.patientId'),dentist_id=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.dentistId'),active=CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.data,'$.active')=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id=NEW.id; END

triggers.name: users_sync_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER users_sync_update AFTER UPDATE OF data ON users BEGIN UPDATE users SET role=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.role'),name=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.name'),patient_id=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.patientId'),dentist_id=json_extract(NEW.data,'$.dentistId'),active=CASE WHEN json_extract(NEW.data,'$.active')=0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END WHERE id=NEW.id; END

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE users(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(data)),role TEXT,name TEXT,patient_id TEXT,dentist_id TEXT,active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN(0,1)))

tables.name: sessions
tables.title: 登录会话
tables.meaning: 仅保存会话令牌摘要、CSRF值与有效期。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),csrf TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: idempotency_requests
tables.title: 幂等请求
tables.meaning: 按账号和操作标识保存请求摘要与可重放结果。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE idempotency_requests(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),key TEXT NOT NULL,request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,response TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(response)),created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,key))

tables.name: rate_limits
tables.title: 限流计数
tables.meaning: 按限流键保存计数和过期时间。
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE rate_limits(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,count INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: audit
tables.title: 审计日志
tables.meaning: 只追加保存操作者、业务操作、目标及脱敏详情。

columns.name: target_id
columns.label: 目标记录编号（多态逻辑引用）

triggers.name: audit_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Audit records are append only'); END

triggers.name: audit_no_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Audit records are append only'); END

tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE audit(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,at TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,type TEXT NOT NULL,target_id TEXT,detail TEXT NOT NULL)

tables.name: payments
tables.title: 收款流水
tables.meaning: 记录经员工核对的现金、银行和POS人工收款。

columns.name: recording_basis
columns.label: 收款记账依据（默认人工核验）

indexes.name: payments_settlement_time
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX payments_settlement_time ON payments(settlement_id, recorded_at)

triggers.name: payments_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER payments_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment ledger is append only'); END

triggers.name: payments_no_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER payments_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Payment ledger is append only'); END

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE payments (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 settlement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES settlements(id),
 amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0 AND amount <= 100000000000),
 method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('cash','bank','pos')),
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 recording_basis TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staff-verified-manual'
)

tables.name: refunds
tables.title: 退款流水
tables.meaning: 关联原收款并保留退款凭证和原因。

indexes.name: refunds_payment_time
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX refunds_payment_time ON refunds(payment_id, recorded_at)

triggers.name: refunds_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER refunds_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Refund ledger is append only'); END

triggers.name: refunds_no_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER refunds_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON refunds BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Refund ledger is append only'); END

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE refunds (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 payment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payments(id),
 amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0 AND amount <= 100000000000),
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
)

tables.name: invoice_adjustments
tables.title: 结算调整流水
tables.meaning: 记录全额冲销；原结算单与原收退款流水仍保留。

indexes.name: invoice_single_void
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invoice_single_void ON invoice_adjustments(settlement_id) WHERE type = 'void'

triggers.name: invoice_adjustments_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER invoice_adjustments_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_adjustments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice adjustments are append only'); END

triggers.name: invoice_adjustments_no_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER invoice_adjustments_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_adjustments BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice adjustments are append only'); END

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE invoice_adjustments (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 settlement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES settlements(id),
 type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type = 'void'),
 amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0 AND amount <= 100000000000),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
)

tables.name: reconciliations
tables.title: 营业日对账
tables.meaning: 按门诊与营业日保存应收渠道额、实核渠道额、签名及修订号。

columns.name: revision
columns.label: 同门诊同营业日修订号

columns.name: expected_cash
columns.label: 来源现金净收款（整数分）

columns.name: expected_bank
columns.label: 来源银行净收款（整数分）

columns.name: observed_cash
columns.label: 实际核对现金净额（整数分）

columns.name: observed_bank
columns.label: 实际核对银行净额（整数分）

indexes.name: reconciliations_clinic_day
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX reconciliations_clinic_day ON reconciliations(clinic_id, business_date, revision DESC)

triggers.name: reconciliations_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER reconciliations_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON reconciliations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Reconciliations are append only'); END

triggers.name: reconciliations_no_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER reconciliations_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON reconciliations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Reconciliations are append only'); END

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE reconciliations (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 clinic_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES clinics(id),
 business_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision > 0),
 expected_cash INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expected_bank INTEGER NOT NULL,
 expected_pos INTEGER NOT NULL,
 observed_cash INTEGER NOT NULL,
 observed_bank INTEGER NOT NULL,
 observed_pos INTEGER NOT NULL,
 source_signature TEXT NOT NULL,
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 UNIQUE(clinic_id, business_date, revision)
)

tables.name: visit_addenda
tables.title: 诊疗附记
tables.meaning: 为已完成就诊追加含作者、原因和原版本的不可变附记。

columns.name: original_version
columns.label: 附记所针对的原就诊版本

indexes.name: visit_addenda_visit_time
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX visit_addenda_visit_time ON visit_addenda(visit_id, recorded_at)

triggers.name: visit_addenda_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER visit_addenda_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON visit_addenda BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Clinical addenda are append only'); END

triggers.name: visit_addenda_no_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER visit_addenda_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON visit_addenda BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Clinical addenda are append only'); END

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE visit_addenda (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 visit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visits(id),
 original_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(original_version > 0),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 content TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 author_name TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: patient_aliases
tables.title: 患者归并别名
tables.meaning: 保留源档案、目标档案、身份核验依据和归并操作者。

triggers.name: patient_aliases_no_update
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER patient_aliases_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON patient_aliases BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Patient aliases are append only'); END

triggers.name: patient_aliases_no_delete
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER patient_aliases_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON patient_aliases BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Patient aliases are append only'); END

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE patient_aliases (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES patients(id),
 target_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(id),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 identity_evidence TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),

)

tables.name: password_reset_tokens
tables.title: 密码恢复凭证
tables.meaning: 保存机构签发的限时单次恢复令牌摘要及核验依据。

columns.name: consumed_at
columns.label: 恢复凭证使用时刻（Unix毫秒）

indexes.name: password_reset_user_expiry
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX password_reset_user_expiry ON password_reset_tokens(user_id, expires_at)

tables.ddl:
CREATE TABLE password_reset_tokens (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
 token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
